label: A GOD_4 with will causing a distinct actual being's esse wills that good for it
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, OPEN bridge, attribution deferred (ST I q.19 a.4 / q.20 a.2 theme). For every GOD_4 g with will and every distinct x in act in esse: if g causes x in esse (the generic causal-responsibility relation of the stage-2 goodness premise), then g wills to x the good x has in esse. The intentional, recipient-directed willing is not contained in causation, in having will or in supreme goodness; this is the causal-to-recipient-willing application the natural-diffusion and foreseen-collateral rivals deny. Reading choice: this statement takes the recipient-directed reading (x's good willed to x, even where x is also ordered to others). The q.20 a.2 ad 3 ordered-love reading, on which an irrational x's existence is willed as ordered to rational creatures and to God, is the weak sibling statement 'Ordered-love reading (q.20 a.2 ad 3): GOD_4 wills a non-rational effect's esse as ordered to others' (disambiguation dd7ff973-0e54-4c93-b9c5-b002cac2b256); it is compatible with this statement. Only its unattributed strong exclusive variant contradicts this statement on distinct non-rational caused effects.
